title: Voodoo and his Catholic upbringing
summary: George took no interest in voodoo because his strict Catholic mother raised him in the church.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: No, I wouldn't say he was interested in that. Didn't pay any attention to it? No. I gather there was a lot of it when he was a boy growing up. But to say believe in it, no, no he didn't.
